title: Melike Turgut portfolio: glossy 3D charms spell "me · like"
note: Lydia: really good portfolio example with motion. Product designer Melike Turgut's site (me · like). A single warm-grey screen where her name splits around a row of eight glossy, inflated 3D charms (bow, flower, bean, pretzel, squiggle, heart, swirl, clover), each one a chapter of her 15-year career, rendered live in WebGL. Tiny uppercase corner labels and a short intro paragraph keep everything else quiet so the objects carry the personality. Also added to her Are.na portfolio channel.
